tools.name: emem_entity
tools.description: Give a real-world object (a bridge, a farm plot, a river, a named place) one shared identity. Every agent resolves this identity the same way. tools.name: emem_locate
tools.description: Get the canonical address (cell64) of a real-world place. Every agent resolves a place to the same cell64, so two models refer to the same ground. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_guard_verdict, emem_ask, search, fetch, emem_echo_verify · Private data: emem_entity, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_entity_link · Public sink: emem_locate, emem_recall, emem_memory_token, emem_verify_receipt, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_tools, emem_ask, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_find_similar, emem_intent · Destructive: emem_verify_receipt, emem_guard_verdict, emem_tools, fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_guard_verdict, emem_ask, search, fetch, emem_echo_verify · Private data: emem_entity, emem_memory_token, emem_memory_token_resolve, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_entity_link · Public sink: emem_locate, emem_recall, emem_memory_token, emem_verify_receipt, emem_memory_contradictions, emem_guard_verdict, emem_tools, emem_ask, emem_echo_verify, emem_entity_resolve, emem_find_similar, emem_intent · Destructive: emem_verify_receipt, emem_guard_verdict, emem_tools, fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
